## Interfaces

Affidavit phase branch at `43bb26e` keeps `bin/aff` and `affidavit/{aa,aa_resolve,check,close_batch,verdict,manifest,amendment,oracle_red,cli,policy}`; `affidavit.aa` resolves via `affidavit.aa_resolve` with no `dashboard` import. Orchestration lives in `~/orchestra` at `4038635` with seven skill slugs, `dashboard/`, `scripts/`, `agents/se-reviewer.md`, plugin manifests named `orchestra`, `contract/project-design.json` with `"project": "orchestra"`, `orchestra/{reviewer,suite,project_field}`, and skills wired to `aff check` / `aff verdict` plus conventional-commit heredocs in `execute-phase` and `ensure-store`. `orchestra.suite` imports `affidavit.check` and records the integration suite check-run; boundary scanner tests cover migrated skills.

## Assumptions

Graded code at `/home/andrewyin/affidavit--orchestration-split` and `/home/andrewyin/orchestra`; live stores read at `/home/andrewyin/affidavit/.artifacts` and `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.artifacts` (not phase-branch `.artifacts` snapshot). Did not invoke `adaptive-artifacts` CLI. Ran acceptance pytest slices and `verify-orchestration-split` shell layout/help command; orchestra full suite needs Textual/uv per its README and was not run wholesale.

## Invariants

Import direction — no `dashboard`/`orchestra` imports under affidavit Python; orchestra imports affidavit. No `tier2` module on either side; `affidavit/tier2.py` absent from both trees. `aff verdict` module doc and implementation use git/manifest only (`_head_passed` is `exit_code == 0`). Live affidavit store has one active goal `evidence-layer` and no dashboard active-goal record files; orchestra holds the five orchestration efforts’ active-goal records. Targeted tests pass: affidavit 128 on integration slice / 133 full; orchestra boundary, task-commit, ensure-store-project, orchestra-package (17).
